easy: Keeping someone or something safe from harm.

ex.en: The tall fence gave shielding from the strong wind.
ex.ko: 높은 울타리가 강한 바람을 막아 주었다.

easy: Thick, dirty mud left over after dirty water is cleaned.

ex.en: Workers scooped the sludge out of the water tank.
ex.ko: 작업자들이 물탱크에서 찌꺼기를 퍼냈다.

easy: A person who works on a team of workers, often in an office.

ex.en: A museum staffer showed us where the dinosaur room was.
ex.ko: 박물관 직원이 공룡 전시실이 어디 있는지 알려 주었다.

easy: A person who says yes to an offer.

ex.en: "Free puppies! Any takers?" the sign said.
ex.ko: "강아지 무료 분양! 데려갈 분?"이라고 팻말에 쓰여 있었다.

easy: A United Nations group that helps children around the world with health, food, and school.

ex.en: Our class collected coins for UNICEF to help kids in need.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 어려운 아이들을 돕기 위해 유니세프에 보낼 동전을 모았다.

easy: Not having insurance, so no company will pay if something goes wrong.

ex.en: The uninsured driver had to pay for the broken window himself.
ex.ko: 보험이 없는 운전자는 깨진 창문값을 직접 물어야 했다.

easy: About the everyday way that ordinary people talk.

ex.en: "Kids" is the vernacular word for "children."
ex.ko: "kids"는 "children"을 일상적으로 부르는 말이다.

easy: A world group that makes rules for buying and selling between countries.

ex.en: The WTO helps countries settle arguments about trade.
ex.ko: 세계 무역 기구는 나라들 사이의 무역 분쟁 해결을 돕는다.

easy: An illness, usually not very serious, that may last a while.

ex.en: Grandpa's ailments include a sore back and stiff knees.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 허리 통증과 뻣뻣한 무릎 같은 병을 앓고 계신다.

easy: Complete destruction, so nothing is left.

ex.en: In the space movie, the planet faced annihilation from a giant asteroid.
ex.ko: 우주 영화에서 그 행성은 거대한 소행성 때문에 완전히 파괴될 위기에 처했다.

easy: Help and support from an important person or group.

ex.en: The science fair was held under the auspices of the city library.
ex.ko: 과학 박람회는 시립 도서관의 후원으로 열렸다.

easy: Helping a chemical change happen faster.

ex.en: Cars have a catalytic part that makes their smoke cleaner.
ex.ko: 자동차에는 배기가스를 더 깨끗하게 만드는 촉매 장치가 있다.

easy: Set up or arranged in a certain way.

ex.en: The new tablets were already configured for our class.
ex.ko: 새 태블릿은 이미 우리 반에 맞게 설정되어 있었다.

easy: From the time long ago when the last dinosaurs, like T. rex, lived.

ex.en: T. rex lived in the Cretaceous period.
ex.ko: 티라노사우루스는 백악기에 살았다.

easy: A factory where strong drinks like whiskey are made by boiling and cooling.

ex.en: We drove past an old stone distillery by the river.
ex.ko: 우리는 강가의 오래된 돌로 지은 증류소 옆을 차로 지나갔다.

easy: Adding more different kinds of things, so you have variety.

ex.en: The farm's diversification into apples and pumpkins made it busier in fall.
ex.ko: 사과와 호박까지 키우는 다양화 덕분에 농장은 가을에 더 붐볐다.

easy: To make a bad problem even worse.

ex.en: Scratching the bug bite only exacerbated the itch.
ex.ko: 벌레 물린 곳을 긁으니 가려움이 더 심해졌다.

easy: When a plan or hard work finally gives the result you wanted, like a tree finally giving fruit.

ex.en: After months of practice, our play came to fruition on opening night.
ex.ko: 몇 달간 연습한 끝에 우리 연극은 첫 공연 날 결실을 맺었다.

easy: In American football, a strong player who runs with the ball and blocks for others.

ex.en: The fullback pushed through the crowd of players for a touchdown.
ex.ko: 풀백이 선수들 사이를 뚫고 나가 터치다운을 했다.

easy: A big old ship moved by sails and many rowers with oars.

ex.en: Hundreds of men rowed the galley across the sea.
ex.ko: 수백 명의 남자가 갤리선의 노를 저어 바다를 건넜다.

easy: A short word for alligator, a big reptile with a wide snout and strong jaws.

ex.en: We saw a gator sunning itself by the swamp in Florida.
ex.ko: 우리는 플로리다 늪가에서 햇볕을 쬐고 있는 악어를 보았다.

easy: All of the same kind, with no big differences.

ex.en: Stir the paint until it is homogeneous, with no streaks.
ex.ko: 줄무늬가 없이 고르게 될 때까지 페인트를 저어라.

easy: Not something you can touch, but still having value.

ex.en: A good name is an intangible thing a business can have.
ex.ko: 좋은 평판은 회사가 가질 수 있는 무형의 재산이다.

easy: Something a business owns that has value but cannot be touched, like a brand name.

ex.en: The company's best intangible is its famous logo.
ex.ko: 그 회사의 가장 큰 무형 자산은 유명한 로고이다.

easy: Having to do with the Jesuits, a group of Catholic priests.

ex.en: My cousin goes to a Jesuit high school.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 예수회 고등학교에 다닌다.

easy: A member of the Jesuits, a group of Catholic priests known for teaching.

ex.en: The Jesuit taught math at the school for forty years.
ex.ko: 그 예수회 수사는 학교에서 40년 동안 수학을 가르쳤다.

easy: A unit that tells how much pure gold is in something; 24 is pure gold.

ex.en: Mom's ring is 14kt gold, so it is mixed with other metals.
ex.ko: 엄마 반지는 14K 금이라서 다른 금속이 섞여 있다.

easy: A person given a big honor or prize for great work.

ex.en: The Nobel laureate visited our school and talked about science.
ex.ko: 노벨상 수상자가 우리 학교에 와서 과학 이야기를 해 주었다.

easy: Making the ground flat and smooth.

ex.en: The leveling of the field took a whole week before the new playground was built.
ex.ko: 새 놀이터를 짓기 전에 땅을 평평하게 고르는 데 꼬박 일주일이 걸렸다.

easy: In American football, a big player who stands at the front line and blocks.

ex.en: The lineman blocked the other team so the quarterback could throw.
ex.ko: 라인맨이 상대 팀을 막아 쿼터백이 공을 던질 수 있었다.

easy: A man who acts wildly, as if he has lost his mind.

ex.en: He ran around the yard like a madman when he saw the bee.
ex.ko: 그는 벌을 보고 미친 사람처럼 마당을 뛰어다녔다.

easy: Wild and out of control.

ex.en: The puppy gave a maniacal bark and chased its tail.
ex.ko: 강아지가 미친 듯이 짖으며 제 꼬리를 쫓았다.

easy: A person who has won a medal.

ex.en: The gold medalist waved from the top of the podium.
ex.ko: 금메달리스트가 시상대 맨 위에서 손을 흔들었다.

easy: A wild, noisy fight or scramble with lots of people.

ex.en: When the piñata broke, there was a melee for the candy.
ex.ko: 피냐타가 터지자 사탕을 차지하려는 아수라장이 벌어졌다.

easy: About big questions like what is real and why things exist.

ex.en: Asking "Why is there anything at all?" is a metaphysical question.
ex.ko: "도대체 왜 무언가가 존재할까?"라고 묻는 것은 형이상학적인 질문이다.

easy: The science of studying the air and telling what the weather will be.

ex.en: She loves storms and wants to study meteorology.
ex.ko: 그녀는 폭풍을 좋아해서 기상학을 공부하고 싶어 한다.

easy: An idea about something that is wrong.

ex.en: It is a misconception that bats are blind.
ex.ko: 박쥐가 앞을 못 본다는 것은 잘못된 생각이다.

easy: For just a short moment.

ex.en: The lights went out momentarily during the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍 중에 불이 잠깐 나갔다.

easy: Thinking you are much more important or special than other people.

ex.en: The narcissistic prince looked in the mirror all day.
ex.ko: 자기도취에 빠진 왕자는 하루 종일 거울만 들여다보았다.

easy: Possible to travel along or across.

ex.en: After the snowplow came, the road was negotiable again.
ex.ko: 제설차가 지나간 뒤 길은 다시 다닐 수 있게 되었다.

easy: A word used to speak to a priest in some churches.

ex.en: "Good morning, Father," we said to the priest after church.
ex.ko: "안녕하세요, 신부님." 우리는 미사가 끝나고 신부님께 인사했다.

easy: All the gods of one religion or people.

ex.en: Zeus was the king of the Greek pantheon.
ex.ko: 제우스는 그리스 신들의 왕이었다.

easy: A person who pays money for something.

ex.en: Dad was the payer when we went out for pizza.
ex.ko: 피자를 먹으러 갔을 때 돈을 낸 사람은 아빠였다.

easy: Made of pictures or shown with pictures.

ex.en: The book gives a pictorial guide to birds.
ex.ko: 그 책은 새를 그림으로 안내해 준다.

easy: A magazine or newspaper with lots of pictures.

ex.en: The Sunday pictorial showed photos of the parade.
ex.ko: 일요일 화보에는 퍼레이드 사진이 실렸다.

easy: A clever trick or plan to get what you want.

ex.en: Asking for one more story was his ploy to stay up late.
ex.ko: 이야기 하나만 더 해 달라는 것은 늦게까지 안 자려는 그의 꾀였다.

easy: Something you believe is true without checking.

ex.en: We made the presumption that the store was open, but it was closed.
ex.ko: 우리는 가게가 열었을 거라고 생각했지만 닫혀 있었다.

easy: About man-made body parts, like a fake leg or arm.

ex.en: The runner won the race with her prosthetic leg.
ex.ko: 그 달리기 선수는 의족을 달고 경주에서 이겼다.

easy: Strongly against new changes, wanting things to stay or go back to the old way.

ex.en: The reactionary group wanted to bring back the old rules.
ex.ko: 반동적인 집단은 옛 규칙을 되살리고 싶어 했다.

easy: A person who strongly fights against new changes in society.

ex.en: The reactionary said all the new laws should be thrown out.
ex.ko: 그 반동주의자는 새 법을 모두 없애야 한다고 말했다.

easy: The soft reddish wood of giant sequoia trees.

ex.en: Our picnic table is made of redwood.
ex.ko: 우리 피크닉 테이블은 레드우드로 만들었다.

easy: Caring only about yourself and not sharing with others.

ex.en: His selfishness showed when he ate all the cookies alone.
ex.ko: 그가 쿠키를 혼자 다 먹었을 때 그의 이기심이 드러났다.

easy: A person in some cultures who is believed to talk with spirits and heal people.

ex.en: The shaman sang and danced to ask the spirits for rain.
ex.ko: 주술사는 비를 내려 달라고 영혼들에게 빌며 노래하고 춤추었다.

easy: Giving only a few main points, not complete.

ex.en: He gave only a sketchy story about how the vase broke.
ex.ko: 그는 꽃병이 어떻게 깨졌는지 대충만 이야기했다.

easy: Brought in or sold secretly and against the law.

ex.en: The police found boxes of smuggled watches at the port.
ex.ko: 경찰은 항구에서 밀수된 시계 상자들을 찾아냈다.

easy: Going toward the south.

ex.en: We got on the southbound train to visit Grandma.
ex.ko: 우리는 할머니를 뵈러 남쪽으로 가는 기차를 탔다.

easy: Being exact and clear about details, not general.

ex.en: The teacher asked for more specificity, like naming the exact bird you saw.
ex.ko: 선생님은 본 새의 이름을 정확히 말하는 것처럼 더 구체적으로 쓰라고 하셨다.

easy: The job of taking care of something for others, like land or money.

ex.en: Under the ranger's stewardship, the forest stayed clean and healthy.
ex.ko: 산림 감시원의 관리 아래 숲은 깨끗하고 건강하게 유지되었다.

easy: A time when something stops or is stopped.

ex.en: A power stoppage froze all the computers at school.
ex.ko: 정전으로 학교의 모든 컴퓨터가 멈췄다.

easy: Pushing or pulling with all your strength.

ex.en: With a lot of straining, we lifted the heavy box.
ex.ko: 우리는 안간힘을 써서 무거운 상자를 들어 올렸다.

easy: Very hard and tiring, using all your strength.

ex.en: With one last straining push, she crossed the finish line.
ex.ko: 마지막으로 안간힘을 다해 그녀는 결승선을 통과했다.

easy: A very powerful country that can affect what happens all over the world.

ex.en: The two superpowers raced to send people to the moon.
ex.ko: 두 초강대국은 사람을 달에 보내려고 경쟁했다.

easy: When things work together to make something better than each could do alone.

ex.en: The two singers had great synergy, and their duet won the prize.
ex.ko: 두 가수는 시너지가 대단해서 이중창으로 상을 받았다.

easy: From or about Tasmania, an island state of Australia.

ex.en: The Tasmanian devil is a small, noisy animal.
ex.ko: 태즈메이니아데빌은 작고 시끄러운 동물이다.

easy: Going on without any stop or gap.

ex.en: An unbroken line of ants marched to the sugar.
ex.ko: 끊이지 않는 개미 행렬이 설탕을 향해 행진했다.

easy: Not yet decided or solved.

ex.en: Where we go on vacation is still unsettled.
ex.ko: 휴가를 어디로 갈지는 아직 정해지지 않았다.

easy: Something so silly that it makes no sense.

ex.en: The absurdity of a fish riding a bike made everyone laugh.
ex.ko: 물고기가 자전거를 탄다는 터무니없는 이야기에 모두 웃었다.

easy: Things that are typical of America and its history, like old signs, quilts, or baseball cards.

ex.en: The diner was full of Americana, like old license plates and jukeboxes.
ex.ko: 그 식당은 오래된 자동차 번호판과 주크박스 같은 미국풍 물건으로 가득했다.

easy: About the parts of the body and how they are built.

ex.en: The poster shows an anatomical drawing of the heart.
ex.ko: 포스터에는 심장의 해부도가 그려져 있다.

easy: A thing, like a germ, that makes your body build defenses to fight it.

ex.en: A vaccine teaches your body to spot an antigen and fight it.
ex.ko: 백신은 몸이 항원을 알아보고 싸우도록 가르친다.

easy: A soft chair with places on each side to rest your arms.

ex.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair reading the newspaper.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 안락의자에서 신문을 읽다가 잠드셨다.

easy: A person paid to take care of children while the parents are out.

ex.en: Our babysitter taught us a new card game.
ex.ko: 우리 베이비시터가 새로운 카드 게임을 가르쳐 주었다.

easy: The job of taking care of children while the parents are out.

ex.en: My big sister earns money by babysitting on weekends.
ex.ko: 언니는 주말에 아이를 돌봐서 돈을 번다.

easy: A person from Bangladesh or the Bengal area of India.

ex.en: My friend's family is Bengali and cooks delicious fish curry.
ex.ko: 내 친구네 가족은 벵골 사람이고 맛있는 생선 카레를 요리한다.

easy: From or about Bengal, an area in Bangladesh and India, or its people.

ex.en: The Bengali tiger is famous for its orange and black stripes.
ex.ko: 벵골 호랑이는 주황색과 검은색 줄무늬로 유명하다.

easy: A bitter green-yellow juice made by the liver that helps break down fat.

ex.en: Bile helps your body digest greasy food.
ex.ko: 담즙은 몸이 기름진 음식을 소화하도록 돕는다.

easy: About the chemical changes that happen inside living things.

ex.en: Digestion is a biochemical process in your stomach.
ex.ko: 소화는 위 속에서 일어나는 생화학적 과정이다.

easy: The land ruled by a caliph, a Muslim leader in history.

ex.en: The old caliphate stretched from Spain to Persia.
ex.ko: 옛 칼리프국은 스페인에서 페르시아까지 뻗어 있었다.

easy: The dead body of an animal.

ex.en: Vultures circled over the carcass of a deer.
ex.ko: 독수리들이 사슴 사체 위를 맴돌았다.

easy: A kind of corgi dog with short legs, round ears, and a long tail.

ex.en: Our Cardigan corgi wags her long, fluffy tail.
ex.ko: 우리 카디건 웰시코기는 길고 푹신한 꼬리를 흔든다.

easy: A moving belt at the airport that brings travelers their bags.

ex.en: We waited at the carousel until our blue suitcase came around.
ex.ko: 우리는 파란 여행 가방이 돌아 나올 때까지 수하물 컨베이어 앞에서 기다렸다.

easy: A very tiny dog from Mexico with big eyes and big ears.

ex.en: The Chihuahua was small enough to fit in her purse.
ex.ko: 그 치와와는 그녀의 핸드백에 들어갈 만큼 작았다.

easy: Rotting leaves, food scraps, and plants mixed together and used to feed soil.

ex.en: We put banana peels in the compost for our garden.
ex.ko: 우리는 텃밭에 쓰려고 바나나 껍질을 퇴비에 넣었다.

easy: To let food scraps and plants rot so they turn into rich soil.

ex.en: Our class composts lunch scraps to feed the school garden.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 점심 찌꺼기를 퇴비로 만들어 학교 텃밭에 준다.

easy: A person who wins a land or people by fighting.

ex.en: The conqueror rode into the city on a white horse.
ex.ko: 정복자는 흰 말을 타고 도시로 들어갔다.

easy: Boldly refusing to obey.

ex.en: The defiant toddler shouted "No!" and crossed his arms.
ex.ko: 반항하는 꼬마는 "싫어!"라고 소리치며 팔짱을 꼈다.

easy: To take away weapons so someone can no longer fight.

ex.en: The police disarmed the robber and took his knife.
ex.ko: 경찰은 강도의 칼을 빼앗아 무장을 해제했다.

easy: A bad part or problem with something.

ex.en: The only drawback of the beach trip was the long drive.
ex.ko: 바닷가 여행의 유일한 단점은 오래 운전해야 한다는 것이었다.

easy: At or near the equator, the imaginary line around the middle of the Earth.

ex.en: Equatorial rainforests are hot and wet all year.
ex.ko: 적도 우림은 일 년 내내 덥고 습하다.

easy: Video games played as a sport in contests, often with teams and big crowds.

ex.en: My cousin wants to be a pro player in esports.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 e스포츠 프로 선수가 되고 싶어 한다.

easy: A story for children about magical creatures like fairies, giants, and talking animals.

ex.en: Cinderella is my sister's favorite fairy tale.
ex.ko: 신데렐라는 여동생이 가장 좋아하는 동화이다.

easy: A wrong idea that comes from bad thinking.

ex.en: It's a fallacy that you can see the Great Wall of China from the moon.
ex.ko: 달에서 만리장성이 보인다는 것은 잘못된 생각이다.

easy: To take care of yourself without help.

ex.en: The baby birds had to fend for themselves after they left the nest.
ex.ko: 아기 새들은 둥지를 떠난 뒤 스스로 살아가야 했다.

easy: Coming up with a big general idea after looking at many small examples.

ex.en: Saying "all swans are white" after seeing a few is a risky generalization.
ex.ko: 몇 마리만 보고 "모든 백조는 하얗다"고 말하는 것은 위험한 일반화이다.

easy: A person who makes jewelry and other things out of gold.

ex.en: The goldsmith made a tiny gold crown for the queen.
ex.ko: 금세공인은 여왕을 위해 작은 금관을 만들었다.

easy: A person who lives alone, far from others, often for religious reasons.

ex.en: The hermit lived in a cave on the mountain and prayed every day.
ex.ko: 은둔자는 산속 동굴에 살며 날마다 기도했다.

easy: Owing thanks to someone who helped you.

ex.en: I am indebted to my neighbor for finding my lost cat.
ex.ko: 잃어버린 고양이를 찾아 준 이웃에게 나는 신세를 졌다.

easy: An official meeting to find out why someone died suddenly.

ex.en: The inquest found that the fall was an accident.
ex.ko: 사인 심리 결과 그 추락은 사고였던 것으로 밝혀졌다.

easy: In the style of old Greek columns with curled tops shaped like scrolls.

ex.en: The museum's front has tall Ionic columns.
ex.ko: 그 박물관 정면에는 높은 이오니아식 기둥이 있다.

easy: A light ringing sound, like coins or bells shaking.

ex.en: I heard the jingle of the cat's bell before I saw her.
ex.ko: 고양이를 보기도 전에 방울이 짤랑거리는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: To make light ringing sounds, like keys or coins shaking together.

ex.en: The coins jingled in my pocket as I ran.
ex.ko: 뛰어갈 때 주머니 속 동전이 짤랑거렸다.

easy: A body of water cut off from the sea by a strip of sand or coral.

ex.en: We swam in the calm, warm laguna behind the reef.
ex.ko: 우리는 산호초 뒤의 잔잔하고 따뜻한 석호에서 수영했다.

easy: A tiny insect with no wings that lives on people or animals and sucks blood.

ex.en: The nurse checked our hair for lice.
ex.ko: 보건 선생님이 우리 머리에 이가 있는지 검사했다.

easy: To mix or put things together.

ex.en: The chef mingled sweet and spicy flavors in the sauce.
ex.ko: 요리사는 소스에 단맛과 매운맛을 섞었다.

easy: An artist who breaks away from old styles to try new ways.

ex.en: The modernist painted people as squares and triangles.
ex.ko: 그 모더니스트는 사람을 네모와 세모로 그렸다.

easy: A worker who helps people move their things to a new home.

ex.en: The movers carried our piano up the stairs.
ex.ko: 이삿짐 운반업자들이 우리 피아노를 계단 위로 날랐다.

easy: Used before a woman's family name from before she married.

ex.en: My mom is Mrs. Kim, née Park.
ex.ko: 우리 엄마는 김 씨 부인이고 결혼 전 성은 박이다.

easy: The big, dry, empty land in the middle of Australia.

ex.en: Kangaroos hopped across the red dirt of the outback.
ex.ko: 캥거루들이 호주 오지의 붉은 흙 위를 깡충깡충 뛰어갔다.

easy: Showing a wide view of a big area, as if seen from high up.

ex.en: From the mountaintop we had a panoramic view of the whole valley.
ex.ko: 산꼭대기에서 우리는 골짜기 전체를 한눈에 내려다보았다.

easy: A photographer who follows famous people to take surprise photos and sell them.

ex.en: A paparazzo hid in the bushes to snap the movie star.
ex.ko: 파파라치가 영화배우를 찍으려고 덤불 속에 숨었다.

easy: To cover a road or path with stones, concrete, or blacktop.

ex.en: Workers paved the dirt road so cars wouldn't get stuck in mud.
ex.ko: 차가 진흙에 빠지지 않도록 일꾼들이 흙길을 포장했다.

easy: Kind and generous in helping poor people.

ex.en: The philanthropic family gave money to build a new library.
ex.ko: 자선을 베푸는 그 가족은 새 도서관을 짓는 데 돈을 기부했다.

easy: A small toy house that children can play inside.

ex.en: We had a tea party in our backyard playhouse.
ex.ko: 우리는 뒷마당 놀이집에서 다과회를 열었다.

easy: To dig up and turn over soil with a big blade before planting.

ex.en: The farmer plowed the field before planting corn.
ex.ko: 농부는 옥수수를 심기 전에 밭을 갈았다.

easy: A farm tool with heavy blades that breaks up and turns over soil.

ex.en: Long ago, horses pulled the plow across the field.
ex.ko: 옛날에는 말이 쟁기를 끌고 밭을 갈았다.

easy: Treating some people better than others in an unfair way.

ex.en: The coach gave preferential treatment to his own son.
ex.ko: 코치는 자기 아들을 편파적으로 대우했다.

easy: A gas with no color that is burned as fuel, like in grills.

ex.en: Dad hooked up a tank of propane to the barbecue grill.
ex.ko: 아빠가 바비큐 그릴에 프로판 가스통을 연결했다.

easy: A strong kind of plastic used for pipes and wire coverings.

ex.en: The plumber used white PVC pipes under the sink.
ex.ko: 배관공은 싱크대 아래에 하얀 PVC 파이프를 썼다.

easy: The holy month when Muslims do not eat or drink from sunrise to sunset.

ex.en: During Ramadan, my friend's family eats dinner after the sun goes down.
ex.ko: 라마단 기간에 내 친구네 가족은 해가 진 뒤에 저녁을 먹는다.

easy: To send something in a new direction.

ex.en: The teacher redirected our attention to the board.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리의 관심을 칠판 쪽으로 돌리셨다.

easy: Without stopping or giving up, again and again.

ex.en: The rain fell relentlessly all weekend.
ex.ko: 비가 주말 내내 쉬지 않고 내렸다.

easy: Able to be used again and again.

ex.en: We bring reusable bags to the grocery store.
ex.ko: 우리는 장 보러 갈 때 재사용 가능한 가방을 가져간다.

easy: A purple flower with orange parts that are dried and used to color and flavor food.

ex.en: Saffron makes the rice turn a bright yellow color.
ex.ko: 사프란을 넣으면 밥이 밝은 노란색으로 변한다.

easy: Talking back in a rude, too-bold way.

ex.en: "Don't be sassy with me," Mom said when I rolled my eyes.
ex.ko: 내가 눈을 굴리자 엄마가 "버릇없이 굴지 마"라고 말씀하셨다.

easy: A boy who goes to school.

ex.en: The schoolboy ran to catch the yellow bus.
ex.ko: 그 남학생은 노란 버스를 잡으려고 뛰어갔다.

easy: A big board that shows the score of a game.

ex.en: The scoreboard lit up when we scored the winning goal.
ex.ko: 우리가 결승골을 넣자 점수판에 불이 들어왔다.

easy: A board with wheels that you stand on and push with one foot to ride.

ex.en: He did a cool jump on his skateboard at the park.
ex.ko: 그는 공원에서 스케이트보드로 멋진 점프를 했다.

easy: To ride on a board with wheels.

ex.en: We skateboarded down the smooth sidewalk.
ex.ko: 우리는 매끈한 인도를 따라 스케이트보드를 탔다.

easy: A person who skis down snowy hills.

ex.en: The skier zoomed down the mountain in a red jacket.
ex.ko: 빨간 재킷을 입은 스키어가 산 아래로 쌩 내려갔다.

easy: To say clearly that something must be done as part of a deal or rule.

ex.en: The rules stipulate that every player must wear a helmet.
ex.ko: 규칙에는 모든 선수가 헬멧을 써야 한다고 명시되어 있다.

easy: A person who wants to overthrow a government or the way society works.

ex.en: The king's guards searched the town for subversives.
ex.ko: 왕의 경비병들은 체제를 뒤엎으려는 사람들을 찾아 마을을 뒤졌다.

easy: A person who has an illness or pain.

ex.en: Allergy sufferers sneeze a lot in spring.
ex.ko: 알레르기 환자들은 봄에 재채기를 많이 한다.

easy: Being right for a certain use or job.

ex.en: We checked the suitability of the hill for sledding.
ex.ko: 우리는 그 언덕이 썰매 타기에 알맞은지 확인했다.

easy: A belief that something brings good or bad luck, without a real reason.

ex.en: It is a superstition that a black cat brings bad luck.
ex.ko: 검은 고양이가 불운을 가져온다는 것은 미신이다.

easy: A big, heavy animal like a goat that lives in the Himalaya mountains.

ex.en: The takin climbed the steep, rocky mountainside.
ex.ko: 타킨이 가파른 바위 산비탈을 올라갔다.

easy: A quick movement, like blinking or twitching, that a person does again and again without meaning to.

ex.en: He has a tic that makes him blink a lot when he is nervous.
ex.ko: 그는 긴장하면 눈을 자주 깜박이는 틱이 있다.

easy: A big, thick, serious book.

ex.en: The professor pulled a dusty old tome off the shelf.
ex.ko: 교수님은 선반에서 먼지 쌓인 두꺼운 책을 꺼냈다.

easy: Run by a government that controls everything and lets people have no freedom.

ex.en: In a totalitarian country, people cannot choose their leaders.
ex.ko: 전체주의 국가에서는 사람들이 지도자를 뽑을 수 없다.

easy: A person who believes a government should control everything.

ex.en: The totalitarian wanted the state to decide every part of people's lives.
ex.ko: 그 전체주의자는 국가가 사람들 삶의 모든 부분을 결정하길 원했다.

easy: A tiny electronic part that controls and makes electric signals stronger.

ex.en: A phone has billions of tiny transistors inside.
ex.ko: 휴대폰 안에는 수십억 개의 작은 트랜지스터가 들어 있다.

easy: A slow, easy kind of running.

ex.en: The pony moved at a gentle trot around the ring.
ex.ko: 조랑말이 원형 마당을 천천히 속보로 돌았다.

easy: To run at a medium speed, with short quick steps.

ex.en: My dog trotted happily beside me on our walk.
ex.ko: 산책할 때 우리 개는 내 옆에서 신나게 종종걸음으로 걸었다.

easy: Not steady, so it may tip over or lean to one side.

ex.en: The unbalanced tower of blocks fell over.
ex.ko: 균형을 잃은 블록 탑이 넘어졌다.

easy: Not good or helpful; making things harder.

ex.en: The picnic was canceled because of unfavorable weather.
ex.ko: 날씨가 좋지 않아 소풍이 취소되었다.

easy: By accident, without meaning to.

ex.en: I unintentionally stepped on my sister's foot.
ex.ko: 나는 무심코 여동생의 발을 밟았다.

easy: Being the only one of its kind.

ex.en: Every snowflake has its own uniqueness.
ex.ko: 눈송이마다 저마다의 독특함이 있다.

easy: One of the small bones that make up your backbone.

ex.en: Your backbone is made of 33 bones, and each one is a vertebra.
ex.ko: 등뼈는 33개의 뼈로 이루어져 있는데 하나하나가 척추뼈이다.

easy: A high sound made by air or steam rushing through a small hole.

ex.en: The whistling of the teakettle told us the water was ready.
ex.ko: 주전자의 삐 소리를 듣고 물이 끓은 것을 알았다.

easy: Parts of a house made of wood, like stairs, door frames, and shelves.

ex.en: Grandpa painted the woodwork around the windows white.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 창문 주변의 나무 부분을 흰색으로 칠하셨다.

easy: How sour or acidic something is.

ex.en: The acidity of lemon juice makes your mouth pucker.
ex.ko: 레몬즙의 신맛 때문에 입이 오므라든다.

easy: A lot of busy, noisy fuss.

ex.en: Without further ado, the show began.
ex.ko: 더 이상 지체 없이 공연이 시작되었다.

easy: Full of fresh air and open space.

ex.en: My new bedroom is bright and airy with big windows.
ex.ko: 내 새 침실은 큰 창문이 있어서 밝고 바람이 잘 통한다.

easy: From or about Alaska, the biggest US state.

ex.en: Alaskan winters are long, dark, and very cold.
ex.ko: 알래스카의 겨울은 길고 어둡고 아주 춥다.
